transcript: Come with me to make my West End debut at guys and dolls. Now, I did not know that I would be making my West End debut when I bought these tickets, but I did know that this production of guys and dolls was very special in that it is incredibly immersive and interactive, especially if you are standing on the floor like I was. Now, because I had never experienced the show before, I brought my friend Mickey Joe Theater, who has seen the show many times and knew all of the best places to stand. And as it turns out, one of those location included the opportunity to be asked to go up on stage. During the title number. I was guided on stage by a cast member, walked down a little runway, they spun me around, uh, and then another cast member came and walked me off the stage. In the context of the show, I was one of the guys being mentioned in the song guys and dolls, which, yes, means I was basically the titular role. Now, despite the importance of my role, I was not invited to bow with the rest of the cast, which was disappointing because I received rave reviews for my performance from other audience members during intermission and after the show. Really, I was a big fan favourite, and I guess they didn't want me to overshadow some of the other cast members. Overall, it was a super cool experience. And now That I am a certified West End star. I am seeking representation if anyone out there is interested. But if you, like me, are chasing stardom, then go to guys and dolls on the West End, and you just might get your big break.
classificationReason: Creator attended and reviewed an immersive West End production of Guys and Dolls, even participating on stage, but this production is not on the provided list
